_comment: Curated breadth grid for the home page. The featured deck is identified by featured: true (positional order is not load-bearing — the implementer should select by flag, not by index). Featured deck plays inline on click; remaining decks link through to detail pages. See HOMEPAGE-IMPLEMENTATION-PROMPT.md §5.2 and §6.3. Operator-managed via git; no DB query at home-page render. File belongs at frontend/config/homepage-featured-decks.json. Thumbnail and deck URLs follow the canonical nginx serving pattern from CLAUDE.md §15.7: https://lessoncraftstudio.com/<locale>/decks/<slug>/. The topic field supports the no-two-thumbnails-on-same-topic invariant from HOMEPAGE-SAVE-STATE.md Section 2.

decks.title: Picture Sudoku
decks._note: Featured tile — plays inline on click. Picked per Section-2 curation v1 doc: visually rich and broadly familiar; image-sudoku rendering is immediately legible as 'this is a real K-3 worksheet'; demonstrates inline-play affordance well.

_known_state_notes: Deck titles are operator-authored at app-side and stored verbatim per row in the DB. Post-Phase-3a, locale heterogeneity is observable: some DE rows carry DE-native titles (e.g. 'Additionsspaß', 'Wörter suchen') while others carry English-language titles (e.g. 'Match Up', 'More or Less Practice'). The titles above mirror DB state verbatim; do NOT auto-translate or normalize. Per CLAUDE.md §17.5 Tier 1 EN+DE discipline, operator may revise specific titles in a future content-authoring pass.
_growth_plan: Section-2 curation v1 (this commit) ships 8 picks across en + de = 4 + 4. Spec amendment locked: 4-language grid (en+de+fr+es) deferred to Tier 2-3 launches per CLAUDE.md §19. When es lands at Tier 2, swap 1 en + 1 de for 2 es picks. When nl lands, same shape. fr lands at Tier 4. Catalog post-Phase-3a is 58 published rows across 29 §14.10-canonical apps × en + de. Selection criteria per SECTION-2-CURATION-v1.md: 4 subjects covered (math 3, letters 2, logic 2, spatial-reasoning 1); 8 distinct mechanics (no app appears twice); 4 themed + 4 themeless; 3 educational levels (preschool 1, kindergarten 5, grade-1 2).
